facts.note: Twenty blocks of churchyard from the lychgate to the chapel door: long enough that the yard's own track has room to start while the party walks up through the stones, short enough that the door is in plain sight from the gate.
Thirteen blocks of nave from the door to the altar step: the walk in is a few seconds of the fifteen-second fade, so the party is standing at the bell while the yard's track is still dying away.
